title: Crispy Mexican Fennel Fritters
description: A flavorful and crunchy snack featuring the perfect combination of Mexican spices and tender fennel. Serve warm with your favorite dipping sauce.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (180°C).
In a large bowl, combine the sliced fennel, chopped nuts, and a pinch of paprika.
Add the Mexican spice blend and stir until the fennel is evenly coated.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the fennel mixture into the hot oil.
Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fritters from the oil and drain on paper towels.
Serve the fritters warm with your favorite dipping sauce.
